hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Review current rewards balance and apply accumulated value directly toward statement credits without distraction.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer is visiting the rewards overview with 7300 LBG coins and an active holiday savings goal.
hypotheses.storyTension: Desire to easily check accumulated cash-equivalent value and allocate rewards toward bills efficiently.
hypotheses.customerResolution: View verified points balance, check holiday goal progress, and initiate a direct statement credit application.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Seamless visibility and application of cash-equivalent reward value to statement credits.
